claims: Amy Madigan won the Academy Award for Best Supporting Actress in 2026 for her performance in the horror film Weapons.
Amy Madigan's victory was at the 98th Academy Awards on March 15, 2026.
Amy Madigan's 2026 Academy Award win was her first Oscar win.
Amy Madigan's 2026 Oscar nomination was her first nomination in 40 years.
In Weapons, Amy Madigan portrayed Aunt Gladys.
Aunt Gladys is revealed to be a witch in Weapons.
Amy Madigan won Outstanding Performance by a Female Actor in a Supporting Role at the SAG Awards.
Amy Madigan won Best Supporting Actress at the Critics' Choice Awards.
New York Film Critics Circle named Amy Madigan Best Supporting Actress.
Amy Madigan set a new Academy record for the longest gap between an actress's first nomination and her first win spanning 40 years and one month.
Amy Madigan's previous nomination was in Best Supporting Actress for the 1985 film Twice in a Lifetime.
Teyana Taylor was nominated for Best Supporting Actress for One Battle After Another.
Wunmi Mosaku was nominated for Best Supporting Actress for Sinners.
Elle Fanning was nominated for Best Supporting Actress for Sentimental Value.
Inga Ibsdotter Lilleaas was nominated for Best Supporting Actress for Sentimental Value
